activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

auto_extension.help: Yes: when the quotation expires, Validity To is automatically extended by the selected quantity of days / months / quarters / years.

bill_number.help: Bill number associated with this quotation

cd_number.help: CD number associated with this quotation

fare_product_id.help: Select the fare/product for this quotation

list.arch:
<tree default_order="name desc" decoration-warning="is_sent_overdue == True">
                <field name="is_sent_overdue" modifiers="{"readonly": true, "column_invisible": true}"/>
                <field name="priority" widget="priority"/>
                <field name="issue_date"/>
                <field name="name" string="Quotation No." modifiers="{"readonly": true, "required": true}"/>
                <field name="user_id" string="Salesperson"/>
                <field name="partner_id" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                <field name="bill_number" string="BILL#"/>
                <field name="cd_number" string="CD#"/>
                <field name="commodity_id" string="Commodity"/>
                <field name="pol_id" string="POL" on_change="1"/>
                <field name="pod_id" string="POD" on_change="1"/>
                <field name="company_id" optional="show" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                <!--                <field name="unit_id"/>-->
<!--                <field name="qty_id"/>-->
<!--                <field name="price_id"/>-->
                <field name="state" string="Status" on_change="1" modifiers="{"required": true}"/>
                <field name="date_end" string="Valid"/>
                <field name="auto_extension" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="remark" string="Remark"/>
            </tree>

form.arch: Customer COM

search.arch:
<search string="Shipments">
                <field name="name"/>
                <field name="partner_id"/>
                <separator/>
                <filter string="Air Carriage" name="air_carriage" domain="[('transport_mode', '=', 'air')]"/>
                <filter string="Ocean Carriage" name="ocean_carriage" domain="[('transport_mode', '=', 'sea')]"/>
                <filter string="Land Carriage" name="land_carriage" domain="[('transport_mode', '=', 'land')]"/>
                <separator/>
                <!-- Gần hết hạn: Validity To trong 7 ngày tới (tính cả hôm nay), bỏ báo giá đã hủy -->
                <filter string="Expiring Soon" name="expiring_soon" domain="[('state', '!=', 'cancel'), ('date_end', '>=', context_today().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')), ('date_end', '<', (context_today() + relativedelta(days=8)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))]"/>
                <filter string="Auto Extension" name="auto_extension" domain="[('auto_extension', '=', 'yes')]"/>

                <!--                    <filter string="Transport Mode" name="group_by_transport_mode"-->
                <!--                            context="{'group_by': 'transport_mode'}"/>-->
